title: Windows User Added to Administrators or Remote Desktop Users
description: Alert-ready search for Security Event 4732 additions to the local Administrators or Remote Desktop Users groups.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4732' and ('Target User Name' like '*Administrators*' or 'Target User Name' like '*Remote Desktop Users*' or msg like '*Administrators*' or msg like '*Remote Desktop Users*') | stats count as GroupAdds by User, 'Target User Name', 'Host Name (Server)' | sort -GroupAdds
